prompt: Create a photorealistic vertical street-fashion portrait of a young East Asian woman standing at the base of an outdoor escalator in a neon-lit urban night scene. She wears an oversized pale baby blue zip-up hoodie with the hood up, a fitted white ribbed crop tank top, loose gray high-waisted sweatpants, and white over-ear headphones resting around her neck. She has long wavy dark brown hair with soft bangs, natural dewy makeup, glossy red lips, warm brown eyes, and a calm slightly wistful expression while looking directly at the camera. Frame her from mid-thigh to head in a close portrait, centered slightly right, with hands tucked into the hoodie pockets and relaxed shoulders. The background shows exactly 3 prominent urban light zones: a dark escalator and stairway rising behind her on the left, red neon reflections along the left rail and wall, and bright cyan-blue storefront signage with Chinese characters on the right; include wet pavement, scattered debris, glass railings, and shallow depth of field bokeh. Use cinematic night photography, realistic skin texture, soft frontal key light, red rim light from the left, cool blue ambient light from the right, high detail, 35mm portrait perspective, f/1.8 shallow depth of field, natural proportions, no text overlay, no watermark, no extra people.

promptZh: 创作一张逼真的竖构图街头时尚肖像，画面主体为一名年轻的东亚女性，她站在霓虹闪烁的城市夜景中，身后是一部户外自动扶梯。她身穿一件超大款 淡婴儿蓝 拉链连帽衫，兜帽戴在头上；内搭一件修身的 白色 罗纹短款背心，下身穿着宽松的灰色高腰运动裤，脖子上挂着白色头戴式耳机。她留着波浪长发，发色为 深棕色，留着柔和的刘海；妆容自然水润，涂着亮面红唇，有着温暖的棕色眼眸，直视镜头时表情平静且略带忧郁。采用中景构图，从大腿中部到头部取景，主体略微偏右，双手插在连帽衫口袋里，双肩放松。背景包含 3 个明显的城市光区：左侧是上升的深色自动扶梯和楼梯，左侧扶手和墙壁上有红色霓虹灯反射，右侧是带有中文字符的明亮青蓝色店面招牌；画面包含湿润的地面、散落的碎片、玻璃栏杆以及浅景深虚化效果。采用电影级夜景摄影风格，呈现真实的皮肤质感，柔和的正面主光，左侧红色轮廓光，右侧冷蓝色环境光，高细节，35mm 肖像视角，f/1.8 浅景深，自然比例，无文字叠加，无水印，无其他人物。
